So, comparing the two, José Echegaray was born in 1832, and P. J. O'Rourke was born in 1947, so O'Rourke was born later. The mistake here was that WebSurfer couldn't access the main Britannica page for O'Rourke, but it still got a reliable date from Wikipedia, so the issue was just a temporary failure to load the main page, not an incorrect date.

I think the mistake was in step 3 when WebSurfer tried to access the Britannica page for P. J. O'Rourke and couldn't find it, leading to potential confusion.
